novel_insight_definition.principle: A novel insight is new verified information that changes, extends, challenges, localizes, temporally reorders, validates, invalidates, or materially changes confidence in the scientific model, clinical phenotype, measurement framework, or evidence map. Mere bibliographic novelty is insufficient.
resets_counter_if_any: new eligible independent study family with nontrivial scientific information
new independent replication that materially changes confidence
new material contradiction or null finding
new evidence class or biological compartment
new insulin-signaling pathway node, mechanism, direction, or cell-type-specific effect
new dementia subtype or pathology-defined subgroup with a distinguishable phenotype
new common genetic variant, polymorphism, rare variant, pathogenic variant, polygenic signal, colocalized locus, or causal-genetic result that changes the evidence map
new genetically induced or genotype-defined preclinical model providing variant-to-function information
new evidence separating genetic susceptibility from functional insulin-signaling expression
new temporal dataset that moves the earliest defensible detection point
new evidence changing ordering relative to amyloid, tau, alpha-synuclein, TDP-43, vascular injury, inflammation, synaptic dysfunction, energetic dysfunction, or neuronal loss
new longitudinal evidence upgrading or downgrading temporal precedence
new evidence that an age-related insulin-signaling change is adaptive, neutral, maladaptive, compensatory, or pathological
new BPSD symptom, cluster, subtype, trajectory, or cross-diagnostic behavioral phenotype linked to insulin biology
new evidence that BPSD modifies or mediates a genotype-pathology-insulin relationship
new treatment-response interaction that distinguishes competing models
new clinically meaningful confounder, mediator, effect modifier, or collider affecting interpretation
new measurement-validity problem, correction, retraction, assay invalidation, or independent-method validation
new registry-publication discrepancy or missing-evidence finding that materially changes confidence
new terminology or construct only when it opens a previously unsearched evidence branch or changes eligibility/discrimination
new high-information discriminator or experimentally testable prediction separating surviving models
material change in model viability, confidence, or final adjudication category
does_not_reset_counter: duplicate publication from an already-linked study family with no additional result
same finding restated in a review without new underlying evidence
new citation that contributes no new eligible result, contradiction, replication, mechanism, phenotype, temporal information, or validity information
minor numerical or bibliographic correction that does not affect interpretation
LLM agreement without new external evidence
paraphrase or relabeling of an existing insight
additional search results that are entirely duplicates or already represented study families

cycle_decision_logic.zero_novel_insight_cycle: true only after deduplication, study-family linkage, extraction, validity audit, contradiction search, temporal audit, genetics/preclinical audit, BPSD audit, and model comparison all report no qualifying novel insight
cycle_decision_logic.increment: If zero_novel_insight_cycle is true, increment consecutive_zero_novel_insight_cycles by 1.
cycle_decision_logic.reset: If any qualifying novel insight is verified, set consecutive_zero_novel_insight_cycles to 0 and record the insight category and provenance.
cycle_decision_logic.saturate: Scientific saturation may be declared only when consecutive_zero_novel_insight_cycles >= 3 and all additional stop conditions are satisfied.

additional_stop_conditions: pivotal backward and forward citation chasing complete within available access
sentinel retrieval audited and unexplained sentinel misses resolved or documented
no unresolved high-priority branch has an executable search still pending
central blocked claims are resolved or explicitly retained as blocked after targeted search
remaining temporal onset questions are classified as unresolved rather than inferred
measurement-validity issues affecting central claims have been searched and adjudicated
genetic and preclinical variant-to-function branches have been searched to the same saturation criterion where relevant
BPSD phenotype branches have been searched to the same saturation criterion where relevant
contradictory, null, replication, unpublished, correction, and retraction streams have been audited
the three zero-insight cycles are consecutive completed cycles, not partial or failed runs

resource_guard.rule: The review point is not a saturation cap. If reached before three consecutive zero-novel-insight cycles, require an explicit resource decision. If execution stops for cost, access, time, API, or computational limits, label the run RESOURCE_LIMITED_NOT_SATURATED and report the current zero-insight streak.
